    "year == 2020"
).copy()

# Remove countries without tb incidence
analysis = analysis.dropna(
    subset=["tb_incidence"]
)

# Save cleaned dataset

    "data/analysis_dataset.csv",
    index=False
)

)

```{python}
# Pairwise relationship
# reveal whether countries with stronger health systems also have lower TB incidence.
fig = px.scatter_matrix(
    analysis,
    dimensions=[
        "tb_incidence",
        "physicians",
        "uhc",
        "spi_overall",
        "health_expenditure",
    ],
    opacity=0.7,
    title="Relationships Between Indicators",
)

fig.show()
```


```{python}

# TB incidence vs Physicians
fig = px.scatter(
    analysis,
    x="physicians",
    y="tb_incidence",
    hover_name="country",
    size="health_expenditure",
    color="spi_overall",
    title="TB Incidence vs Physician Density",
)

fig.update_layout(
    xaxis_title="Physicians per 1,000", yaxis_title="TB Incidence per 100,000"
)
```


```{python}
# Top countries by TB burden
top_tb_countries = analysis_full.nlargest(10, "tb_incidence")[["country", "tb_incidence"]]

# Lowest physician density
low_physician_den = analysis_full.nsmallest(10, "physicians")[["country", "physicians"]]

# Correlation matrix
corr = analysis_full[
    [
        "tb_incidence",
        "physicians",
        "uhc",
        "spi_overall",
        "spi_pillar5",
        "health_expenditure",
    ]
].corr()

# Correlation matrix heatmap
fig = px.imshow(
    corr,
    text_auto=".2f",
    color_continuous_scale="RdBu_r",
    aspect="auto",
    title="Correlation Matrix",
)
```
